mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields in equities.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market and strong job growth leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in two consecutive months signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply chain strengthening are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2% indicates slowing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increasing by more than 50 basis points in a single month signals a rapid monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to potentially reduced borrowing and spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 50bps, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in two consecutive months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 100K, the combined signal of a weakening labor market leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.5% for 2 consecutive months and PAYEMS growth < 100K
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market downturns and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 30% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the level of industrial production (INDPRO) being above its 5-year average indicates a resilient supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when INDPRO is above its 5-year average are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
